metadata.title: EDI and B2B Document Exchange Data Assets
metadata.description: Catalog of network, configuration, business-document, status, archive and account data in the Transus platform, hosted in EU data centres (Frankfurt, DR Amsterdam) under an ISO 27001 ISMS.

rootGroups.name: Network and Configuration Data
rootGroups.description: Who can trade with whom, and how.

subGroups.name: Partners and Requirements
subGroups.description: The network graph and partner specifications.

assets.name: Trading Partner Profile
assets.description: An organisation on the Transus network: names, GLNs, VAT and Peppol identifiers, supported document types and connection status.
assets.businessMeaning: The network itself; the reason a new customer can often connect within a day.
assets.accessScope: Searchable capability data public; contact data internal

interfaces.name: trading partner profile api
interfaces.description: Access to trading partner profile through the owning brick.

governance.retention: Kept while the partner is reachable; archived after deactivation
governance.sharingPolicy: Capability data is shown in the public partner search

assets.name: Partner Message Specification
assets.description: Versioned message implementation guideline per partner and document type (segments, code lists, mandatory fields, SSCC and invoice rules).
assets.businessMeaning: Captured retailer know-how; much of what customers pay Transus for.

interfaces.name: partner message specification api
interfaces.description: Access to partner message specification through the owning brick.

governance.retention: All versions kept for traceability of past messages
governance.sharingPolicy: Not shared outside Transus except with the partner concerned

assets.name: Partner Connection
assets.description: A configured relationship between a customer and a trading partner: documents, direction, route, mapping version and lifecycle state.
assets.businessMeaning: Each connection is a unit of value delivered and a unit of churn risk.

interfaces.name: partner connection api
interfaces.description: Access to partner connection through the owning brick.

governance.retention: Kept for the life of the contract plus statutory period

subGroups.name: Mappings and Integration
subGroups.description: How in-house formats are transformed and systems are connected.

assets.name: Mapping Definition
assets.description: Transformation rules from a customer in-house format to a partner standard and back, including AI-proposed mappings awaiting approval.
assets.businessMeaning: Encodes both the customer system and the partner requirement; the asset Traci AI aims to generate.
assets.accessScope: Transus EDI specialists and certified partners

interfaces.name: mapping definition api
interfaces.description: Access to mapping definition through the owning brick.

governance.retention: Versions kept while messages using them are retained

assets.name: ERP Integration Configuration
assets.description: Endpoints, file drops, credentials references and connector settings for a customer ERP, WMS or Katapull sibling system.
assets.businessMeaning: Determines whether documents flow without manual steps.
assets.accessScope: Customer IT, certified partner, Transus support

interfaces.name: erp integration config api
interfaces.description: Access to erp integration configuration through the owning brick.

governance.retention: Deleted at contract end
governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with the customer's certified partner only

assets.name: Transport Credential
assets.description: AS2 certificates, SFTP keys and API secrets used for partner sessions.
assets.businessMeaning: Compromise would let an attacker inject or read orders and invoices.

interfaces.name: transport credential api
interfaces.description: Access to transport credential through the owning brick.

governance.retention: Rotated per policy; revoked at connection end

rootGroups.name: Business Document Data
rootGroups.description: The documents of the order-to-cash and replenishment cycle.

subGroups.name: Exchanged Messages
subGroups.description: What actually flows over the network.

assets.name: EDI Interchange
assets.description: Raw interchange as received or sent (EDIFACT, UBL, XML, CSV), with envelope metadata.
assets.businessMeaning: Proof of what was exchanged with whom and when.
assets.accessScope: Customer, its trading partner and Transus support

interfaces.name: edi interchange api
interfaces.description: Access to edi interchange through the owning brick.

governance.retention: Retained per contract; typically months online then removed
governance.sharingPolicy: Visible to the two parties of the exchange

assets.name: Purchase Order Document
assets.description: Orders, order changes and order responses (ORDERS, ORDCHG, ORDRSP) in canonical and partner form.
assets.businessMeaning: The start of every delivery and invoice.

interfaces.name: purchase order document api
interfaces.description: Access to purchase order document through the owning brick.

governance.retention: Retained with the interchange

assets.name: Despatch Advice Document
assets.description: DESADV with packing hierarchy, SSCCs, batches and best-before dates.
assets.businessMeaning: Lets retailer DCs and logistics providers plan receipt.

interfaces.name: despatch advice document api
interfaces.description: Access to despatch advice document through the owning brick.

governance.retention: Retained with the interchange
governance.sharingPolicy: Shared with retailer and its logistics provider

assets.name: SSCC Label Record
assets.description: Allocated serial shipping container codes and the label content printed for each pallet.
assets.businessMeaning: Hornbach and other retailers reject deliveries without valid SSCC labels.

interfaces.name: sscc label record api
interfaces.description: Access to sscc label record through the owning brick.

governance.retention: Kept to prevent SSCC reuse (GS1 rule)

assets.name: Invoice Document
assets.description: Invoices and credit notes as EDIFACT INVOIC, UBL/Peppol BIS, XRechnung or ZUGFeRD.
assets.businessMeaning: Gets the supplier paid and satisfies e-invoicing law.

interfaces.name: invoice document api
interfaces.description: Access to invoice document through the owning brick.

governance.retention: Retained per contract; archived copy follows tax retention
governance.sharingPolicy: Visible to the two parties and Peppol access points

assets.name: Inventory and Forecast Report
assets.description: Retailer stock levels, sales and forecasts used for vendor managed inventory.
assets.businessMeaning: Commercially sensitive retailer data that the supplier may only use for replenishment.

interfaces.name: inventory and forecast report api
interfaces.description: Access to inventory and forecast report through the owning brick.

governance.retention: Rolling window needed for replenishment
governance.sharingPolicy: Only the retailer and the supplier concerned

assets.name: Message Status Event
assets.description: Lifecycle event per message: received, translated, validated, delivered, acknowledged, failed.
assets.businessMeaning: The basis of real-time insight shared with trading partners.

interfaces.name: message status event api
interfaces.description: Access to message status event through the owning brick.

governance.retention: Kept as long as the message

assets.name: Message Exception
assets.description: A blocked, failed or late message with a plain-language reason, owner and resolution.
assets.businessMeaning: Where customer trust is won or lost.

interfaces.name: message exception api
interfaces.description: Access to message exception through the owning brick.

governance.retention: 24 months for trend analysis

assets.name: Document Archive Record
assets.description: Immutable archived copy of an invoice or document with retention metadata.
assets.businessMeaning: Audit evidence for tax authorities.

interfaces.name: document archive record api
interfaces.description: Access to document archive record through the owning brick.

governance.retention: Statutory tax retention (e.g. 7 years in the Netherlands)

assets.name: Message Volume Metric
assets.description: Aggregated volumes, error rates and lead times per customer, partner and document type.
assets.businessMeaning: Shows value delivered under a flat fee and partner performance.

interfaces.name: message volume metric api
interfaces.description: Access to message volume metric through the owning brick.

governance.retention: Aggregates kept indefinitely

assets.name: AI Mapping Training Sample
assets.description: Document samples and specialist feedback used to improve Traci AI recognition.
assets.businessMeaning: Fuels the move from manual mapping to AI-assisted onboarding.

interfaces.name: ai mapping training sample api
interfaces.description: Access to ai mapping training sample through the owning brick.

governance.retention: Pseudonymised; retained per AI data policy (assumption)

assets.name: Customer Subscription
assets.description: Customer account, plan (Basic, Plus, Premium), term and entitlements.
assets.businessMeaning: Drives flat-fee revenue and feature access.

interfaces.name: customer subscription api
interfaces.description: Access to customer subscription through the owning brick.

governance.retention: Contract life plus statutory period

assets.name: User Account
assets.description: Users of customers, partners and trading partners with roles and credentials.
assets.businessMeaning: Controls who can see whose documents.

interfaces.name: user account api
interfaces.description: Access to user account through the owning brick.

governance.retention: Removed after deactivation plus log retention

assets.name: Support Ticket
assets.description: Customer or partner request with linked messages, connections and resolution.
assets.businessMeaning: Records the expert service customers cite as a reason to stay.

interfaces.name: support ticket api
interfaces.description: Access to support ticket through the owning brick.

governance.retention: 36 months (assumption)

assets.name: Security Audit Log
assets.description: Access and configuration changes for ISO 27001 and customer NIS2 assurance.
assets.businessMeaning: Evidence in incidents and supplier audits.

interfaces.name: security audit log api
interfaces.description: Access to security audit log through the owning brick.

governance.retention: At least 12 months (assumption)
governance.sharingPolicy: Excerpts shared with customers in incident handling

stores.name: Network and Configuration DB
stores.description: Partners, profiles, connections, mappings and rules.

stores.name: Message Store
stores.description: Raw and translated interchanges and business documents.

stores.name: Message Status Ledger Store
stores.description: Append-only message lifecycle events and exceptions.

stores.name: Document Archive Vault
stores.description: Retention-managed immutable archive of invoices and documents.

stores.name: Analytics Warehouse
stores.description: Aggregated message metrics and AI training samples.
